NeoCell PURE

Your formulation needs structure.
Not necessarily more thickness.

NeoCell PURE gives formulators another way to build physical structure using fibrillated cellulose.

Request Sample ↗

It is designed to be evaluated not simply as a thickener, but as a material that can help control how a formulation behaves before, during and after application.

Functionalities

Hold dispersed material in place

Evaluate pigments, particles, capsules and other suspended solids.

Flow under shear

The structured network becomes easier to move during mixing, pumping or application.

Recover afterwards

Once shear falls, the cellulose network can rebuild physical structure.

Design texture differently

Explore pickup, spread, break and physical structure beyond peak viscosity alone.

Product properties

Material class
Fibrillated cellulose dispersion
Origin
Cellulose recovered from agricultural residues
Chemistry
Unmodified plant cellulose
Format
Aqueous gel / dispersion
Development focus
Structure · suspension · shear thinning · recovery · texture · co-rheology

Applications

Personal Care

Serums · creams · cleansing systems · texture design

Sun Care

Hair Care

Suspension · texture · film-related evaluation

Other Formulations

Coatings · pigmented systems · water-based formulations

Current testing supports

  • Cellulose-rich material
  • Structured viscoelastic network
  • Pronounced shear thinning
  • Measured post-shear recovery
